reason: Hypothesis A proposes a pack aluminization to form a self-healing alumina scale, which is a well-established, physically sound mechanism for high-temperature oxidation protection in refractory alloys, and it directly addresses oxygen resistance without relying on an ultrathin coating that may fail under thermal cycling.
